description: Land Acquisition - Ataala, Apalathotuwa & Renapana, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. The content falls squarely within the "Land Gazettes" category as it concerns land acquisitions and property matters, without involving government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
